title: Bayesian search identifies organic metallophotocatalyst formulations
summary: Gaussian-process models and chemist decisions guided synthesis and testing of organic photocatalysts for a specified cross-coupling reaction. A catalyst search reached 67% yield before reaction-condition optimization. This establishes a bounded formulation result for the studied reaction, not discovery of the reaction or general superiority to iridium catalysts.
organization: Zhejiang Normal University; University of Liverpool; University of Birmingham; IBM Research

evidence.tested: Candidate catalysts were synthesized and reaction yields measured in repeated experiments.
evidence.unknown: General substrate scope, independent replication and exhaustive molecular prior art were not assessed.
evidence.ai_role: Gaussian-process Bayesian optimization supported the stated study; experimental and interpretive work remained with researchers.

source_review.scope: Primary article abstract, selected Results, computational Methods and publication metadata; supplements not reviewed.
